messages:
Sam: FYI small but repeatable misalignment on magnet-13b int4 during longprefill bringup. observed after ~12.3k tokens, appears as dropped KV slot (shadow has slot N+1). not a full divergence but causes off-by-one generation downstream.
Lina: can you share the minimal run + quant profile? sounds like a compaction race.
Sam: repro:
```bash
./local_infer \
  --model models/magnet13b/int4/bringup-2026-03 \
  --quant-config profiles/int4-stepwise.json \
  --prompt tests/longsequences/24k_seeded.txt \
  --max-tokens 1024 \
  --seed 7 \
  --dump-kv /tmp/kvpage.bin \
  --enable-shadow-run yes
```
Sam: failing output snippet: 
```
[KV] seq=12288 host_slot=614 shadow_slot=615
[WARN] page-boundary-compact triggered
[DIFF] token_idx=12289 tok=<|pad|> reason=slot-offset-mismatch
```
Devon: 12288 == 4096*3, so third page boundary. our weave-evict policy does async compaction on that boundary. can you re-run with WEAVE_EVICT_SYNC=1?
Sam: re-ran 200 times with sync: failures 2/200 -> reduced but not eliminated.
Priya: int4-stepwise uses a small LUT for rotary scale. rounding tiny multipliers can nudge a 16-bit key LSB. over many tokens that accumulates. dump hexdiff around the slot area?
Sam: hexdump window:
```
# host around offset 12280
000250  aa bb cc 10 4f 23 77 00  12 34 56 78 9a bc 00 01  |....O#w..4Vx....|
000260  01 02 03 04 33 21 00 00  11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88  |....3!.....3DUfw.|
# shadow
000250  aa bb cc 10 4f 23 77 00  12 34 56 78 9a bc 00 01  |....O#w..4Vx....|
000260  01 02 03 04 33 22 00 00  11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88  |....3\".....3DUfw.|
```
Sam: again LSB differs (33 21 vs 33 22).
Devon: that's consistent with a single-bit rounding on the rotary-encoded key. two options: 1) fallback to int8 for prefill keys only, 2) make slot hashing deterministic (masking) so compaction doesn't depend on tiny key variance.
Lina: PR idea: introduce KV_SLOT_MASK env var to force deterministic slot mapping (mask applies before compact). small change, gated behind KV_SLOT_MASK=0x0FFF for testing.
Priya: another quick mitigation: increase quant accumulator precision for pos_scale (use 32-bit accumulate or int24 trick) to reduce rounding steps. will prototype.
canary-bot: scheduled eng-ml canary run at 04:30 UTC with KV_SLOT_MASK=0x0FFF and WEAVE_EVICT_SYNC=1 on magnet13b-int4; will run 400 longprefill traces.
Sam: ran local 400-run sweep: combo (mask + sync) -> 0/400; (mask only) 1/400; (sync only) 3/400; (neither) 10/400.
Devon: good signal. plan: land KV_SLOT_MASK behind opt-in, and follow up with accumulator precision PR. add smoke metric: page-boundary-slot-mismatches per 1k tokens.
Lina: opened phab D12345 for mask, D12346 for accumulator. tag: eng-ml/bringup.
Priya: will post microbench numbers for int24-style accumulator vs int32. preliminary looks like negligible perf hit (<0.5%).
Sam: adding a short runbook note under eng-ml/docs/bringup-playbook.md with repro command, hexdiff command, and env flags (KV_SLOT_MASK, WEAVE_EVICT_SYNC).
Devon: assign to oncall for 72h of monitoring, if nightly stays green we can promote mask as default for this model family.
Sam: thanks team. will attach logs & kv dumps to the phab tasks. :thumbsup:
